body: REJECT: O4 is refuted at clean SHA 2f20978. The detached candidate's real smoke server lifecycle was written to the host default $TMPDIR/zellij-501/zellij-log/zellij.log because control helpers omit the disposable HOME/TMPDIR boundary. O1-O3 and recipient behavior passed, but one of five extra responsiveness-mode runs also failed the broad terminal restore snapshot on cursor_coordinates_in_pane [8,2] -> [8,1]. Isolate every control invocation, make the restore oracle deterministic, rerun the exact-range review, then return I1-I2 to CL.
